F.M.STONE, writing from DENE COTTAGE, RAMSGATE ROAD, BROADSTAIRS, KENT, sends his congratulations to Bill Couzens and Charlie Manning on their election to Life Membership, and would like to be remembered to all Belgravians, particularly Harry Hare or any of his other old contempories.
